# Getting help

- **Questions, ideas and debates about picks:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/privacyratings/privacyratings.com/discussions) or [r/privacyratings](https://www.reddit.com/r/privacyratings/).
- **A rating is wrong:** [submit a correction](https://github.com/privacyratings/privacyratings.com/issues/new?template=correction.yml) with evidence.
- **Suggest an app or service:** [suggest an addition](https://github.com/privacyratings/privacyratings.com/issues/new?template=suggest.yml).
- **The website or CLI is broken:** [report a bug](https://github.com/privacyratings/privacyratings.com/issues/new?template=bug.yml).
- **Security problems:** see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Never report them in public.
- **News:** follow [@privacyratings on X](https://x.com/privacyratings).

How to contribute is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
